purpose: Executable inventory of every reviewed state producer at the W0 baseline. This records current entrypoints and durable-ACK boundaries; it does not claim the target Ref-CAS/Blob design is implemented.

status_legend.existing: Code exists at the baseline and is exercised by the named entrypoint; production scope is limited to the notes.
status_legend.partial: Code exists but covers only part of the target producer contract or relies on a local-only/loopback fallback.
status_legend.proposed: No baseline source implementation; must not appear as selectable deployment configuration.

categories.publish: Git ref/pack publication and merge paths that can move a ref.
categories.auth_mutation: Credential, session, membership, team and organization mutations whose decisions gate publication.
categories.root: Persistent reachability/retention roots that protect Git or Blob content from deletion.
categories.hold: Physical artifact/publication protection before durable content becomes reachable.
categories.event: Committed business/Git event producers and delivery leasing.
categories.durable_ack: Points that return or imply durable success to a client or to another service.

entries.authority_current: Native receive-pack writes the persistent bare Git repository directly; PostgreSQL stores admissions, operation metadata, journal reconciliation and outbox projection. Disposable materialized views belong to the separate Pando path.
entries.authority_target: PgRefStore commit of refs/pack epochs; BlobStore durable pack receipt; no persistent bare Git authority
entries.durable_ack: Git success reflects the native persistent bare-repository ref update. Journal and PG reconciliation establish the operation/event outcome; Git filesystem and PG do not share a commit, and no Blob durable receipt is implied.
entries.notes: Pando repositories are routed by repositories.storage_backend; this entry covers the default GitFS path.
gaps: Git filesystem and PG do not share an atomic transaction
persistent bare Git remains the write authority
local hook success is not equivalent to a Blob durable receipt

entries.authority_current: git update-ref --stdin atomic transaction guarded by PG ref admissions and process/volume fences
entries.authority_target: CommitRefs with expected old OID/version and atomic multi-ref result in PgRefStore
entries.durable_ack: HTTP success is returned after the native ref transaction and admission settlement; journal/outbox are PG-side evidence
entries.notes: The exact-ref guard permits some preparation in parallel, but acquire() still serializes through an advisory lock and the local write mutex.
gaps: whole-repository advisory lock and local write mutex remain
Git ref files are the commit authority

entries.authority_current: PG pando_repository_states row locked FOR UPDATE OF s updates refs, pack_ids, ref_generation and operation_sequence in one transaction; events::publish_in_tx writes the outbox before auth::finish_tx commits the same transaction
entries.authority_target: PgRefStore/RaftRefStore CommitRefs with CAS, pack membership, operation result and commit event in one ordered command
entries.durable_ack: Encrypted pack/index/envelope objects have been uploaded and read-back verified in the remote S3-compatible provider before refs, pack membership, operation and outbox commit in PG.
entries.notes: This is the closest existing analogue of Ref-CAS but is not the proposed interface; it still serializes on one PG state row per repository.
gaps: interface is not the proposed CommitRefs contract
no stable cross-service operation result/cancel tombstone protocol
Current PG refs/outbox atomicity exists; the proposed RefStore replayable event/cursor API is absent.

entries.authority_current: PG PR state machine constructs a merge and publishes through the repository backend; PG and Git filesystem/refs do not share a transaction
entries.authority_target: PG merge intent + RefStore CommitRefs(decision, expected old base OID) then idempotent PG finalizer
entries.durable_ack: merge API success requires the publication path and PG merged state; a crash between them is recoverable but is not a cross-store atomic commit
entries.notes: PR merge is a business mutation that also moves a Git ref and must be included in the future scope/decision gate.
gaps: no decision scope CLOSING barrier
no pending merge operation query contract tied to a RefStore commit token

entries.authority_current: PG tokens and repository/team role checks on every authenticated API request
entries.authority_target: PG remains authority; publication decisions must carry a versioned authorization proof and scopes
entries.durable_ack: authentication and revocation decisions are read from PG; no Redis/cache authority
entries.notes: Token expiry and revocation are checked per request; browser sessions additionally depend on a parent token.
gaps: no publication intent/scope registration before a Git mutation
no proof that a decision remained valid between checkout and Git commit

entries.authority_current: PG tokens + web_sessions, HttpOnly cookie, CSRF/Origin checks and parent-token revocation
entries.authority_target: same PG authority plus decision-scope coverage for session revocation
entries.durable_ack: login/logout writes PG state before returning; old cookies are rejected by middleware
entries.notes: Session state must not be moved to Redis as the only copy.
gaps: browser session revocation is not yet wired into a publication scope barrier

entries.authority_current: PG repository_collaborators and team roles aggregated to the highest direct/team role
entries.authority_target: PG authority; every role change increments a decision scope observed by pending publications
entries.durable_ack: role mutation commits in PG before the API returns; authorization reads PG on each request
entries.notes: This is a root producer for the future decision-scope protocol and is not currently observed by Git publishing.
gaps: no persisted scope version or CLOSING state around role changes
concurrent Git publication is not cancelled on revocation

entries.authority_current: PG repository teams/members and organization members/ownership transfer
entries.authority_target: PG authority with organization/repository/team decision scopes
entries.durable_ack: membership/ownership changes commit in PG before API success
entries.notes: Must be included in the future global principal/org scope fan-out.
gaps: no decision-scope registration on organization/team changes

entries.authority_current: PG SQL root inventory (PR/CI/workspace/checkpoint/change set/sandbox) plus native refs; GC takes a write admission fence
entries.authority_target: RefStore roots/pins and PG artifact holds; GC cuts validated against both
entries.durable_ack: GC only becomes destructive after the admission fence and verified retention roots
entries.notes: The SQL root inventory is the baseline source for the target roots bridge; no RefStore roots exist yet.
gaps: RefStore RegisterRoot/ReleaseRoot do not exist
new root producers can be missed unless every writer is enumerated

entries.authority_current: Independent retention sources: native refs/rootyard-ci/*, local filesystem pin intents/receipts, and PG outbox pin history. ci_checkout_jobs tracks checkout leases; there is no ci_source_pins table.
entries.authority_target: PG business root + RefStore pin for exact OID closure
entries.durable_ack: CI pin lifecycle writes its backend-specific native ref and filesystem intent/receipt, with PG event history; active_pinned_oids unions these roots before eviction.
entries.notes: Checkout leases and mirror eviction rows are distinct from source-pin roots. Migrations 008/030 define ci_checkout_jobs and ci_mirror_evictions, not a PG source-pin authority.
gaps: pin lifecycle is backend-specific and not a RefStore root
cross-group ChangeSet roots are not atomic

entries.authority_current: PG workspace/checkpoint metadata; local filesystem checkpoint state (local_filesystem_only) and optional remote object publication (remote_verified)
entries.authority_target: BlobStore durable manifest + RefStore Git dependency root; no local-only durable ACK
entries.durable_ack: create() records local_complete/local_filesystem_only; remote publish() upgrades to committed/remote_verified
entries.notes: The local-only state is an explicitly reviewable gap: it must not be reported as durable Blob success.
gaps: local_complete can be mistaken for durable checkpoint success
no BlobStore durable receipt or Git dependency root

entries.authority_current: offline paired PG dump + data volume + LFS inventory; Pando export/import closure
entries.authority_target: coordinated PG cut + RefStore snapshot + OpenDAL Blob archive with immutable manifest last
entries.durable_ack: backup create() writes a manifest only after PG/volume/LFS checks; restore() is isolated and validated
entries.notes: There is no coordinated multi-group RefStore cut or Blob backup archive yet.
gaps: no Raft snapshot/log tail pairing
no immutable Blob backup manifest

entries.authority_current: PG pando_remote_artifacts, pando_manifest_artifacts and pando_publication_fences; singleton storage authority and lease windows
entries.authority_target: PG global artifact hold ledger keyed by hold_id + generation + artifact identity; RefStore consumes receipts
entries.durable_ack: reserve/activate must succeed before a pack is referenced; physical delete is gated by the retention ledger
entries.notes: This is the existing analog of the cross-store hold bridge, not the target hold protocol.
gaps: one-hour lease is not a target persistent hold
no RefStore-issued retirement receipt
reserve lock on the singleton storage authority is a cross-repository hotspot

entries.authority_current: PG artifact ledger + storage lifecycle job; remote delete is disabled by default
entries.authority_target: RefStore RetireClosure -> PG ReleaseArtifactHold -> exact-generation physical delete
entries.durable_ack: job finish records a terminal result only after ledger checks; deletion is an explicit separate operation
entries.notes: Remote deletion for the proposed Raft backend is not enabled by this baseline.
gaps: no target hold generation handoff
late DELETE fencing relies on the current local/object adapter

entries.authority_current: PG storage_write_admissions + git_ref_admissions + local process/volume fences
entries.authority_target: RefStore epoch fence plus PG hold ledger; process-local lock is not a target fence
entries.durable_ack: admission is acquired before write; epoch settlement is a PG transaction
entries.notes: This protects the legacy GitFS backend and must not be renamed into a RefStore implementation.
gaps: admission/fence state is tied to the legacy backend
no RefStore generation/retirement receipt

entries.authority_current: PG outbox/event rows claimed with leases; Redis/Kafka are wake/transport adapters only
entries.authority_target: Git commit events produced by RefStore CommitRefs and projected idempotently into PG; business outbox remains PG
entries.durable_ack: PG row commit is the reliable event source; delivery lease acknowledgement is also PG
entries.notes: At-least-once delivery and unique event IDs are already the baseline pattern to preserve.
gaps: Git commit events are not atomically produced by a RefStore command
projection offset/incarnation contract is not implemented

entries.authority_current: GitFS operation journal under the data volume plus PG reconciliation
entries.authority_target: RefStore operation result/commit event; PG projection only
entries.durable_ack: an operation is unknown/recovering until reconciliation proves a terminal Git state
entries.notes: The journal is legacy-backend evidence and is not the proposed RefStore operation record.
gaps: journal files and PG events are not atomic
recovery depends on local volume access

entries.authority_current: PG webhook subscriptions/deliveries with HMAC signing, retry and dead letter; worker claims are PG-backed
entries.authority_target: unchanged PG business outbox; project Git commit events into it
entries.durable_ack: delivery status is advanced in PG; external HTTP delivery is at-least-once and is not exactly-once
entries.notes: Stable delivery/event IDs must remain stable when the event source moves to RefStore.
gaps: no projection of RefStore events into webhook outbox
no dedup key spanning old and new event sources

entries.authority_current: native receive-pack result + journal completion + PG projection; Git filesystem is the durable content authority
entries.authority_target: BlobStore pack receipt + PgRefStore CommitRefs token; native local success is not forwarded as durable success
entries.durable_ack: client success means the Git ref transaction completed and the journal/PG evidence path accepted it; it does not mean cross-store atomicity
entries.notes: W0 baseline runner measures local Git cost only; it cannot validate this ACK against a native service without a permitted runtime.
gaps: no Blob durable receipt
unknown-write query is operation-based but not the proposed GetOperation/commit token contract

entries.authority_current: staged local LFS object + fsync + PG lfs_objects row; remote object store optional and falls back to local when no endpoint
entries.authority_target: BlobStore verified upload receipt + PG metadata; local disk is cache only
entries.durable_ack: verify/upload success requires a local durable object with matching SHA-256/size before PG linkage
entries.notes: remote_store() returns None without ROOTYARD_OBJECT_STORE_ENDPOINT, which is the explicit local fallback the target forbids for production.
gaps: local-only durable ACK path
no OpenDAL BlobStore receipt or generation

entries.authority_current: checkpoint create returns local_complete/local_filesystem_only; remote publish upgrades to committed/remote_verified
entries.authority_target: BlobStore manifest receipt required before committed; local working tree is not durable authority
entries.durable_ack: local_complete is not a Blob-durable ACK; only remote_verified/committed claims carry a manifest digest
entries.notes: A local checkpoint can be recovered on the same volume, but it does not satisfy the target clear-compute-cache recovery test.
gaps: local-only checkpoint state remains reachable
no Blob receipt/size/length verification contract

entries.authority_current: backup manifest written after PG dump, volume archive and LFS/remote checks; destination is an operator-selected path
entries.authority_target: immutable OpenDAL Blob backup manifest published last, with PG + RefStore cuts paired
entries.durable_ack: backup completion is only reported after restore checks and manifest write; there is no Blob upload receipt
entries.notes: Backup destination is local/operator-managed at baseline.
gaps: manifest is not an immutable Blob object
no paired RefStore backup cut

entries.authority_current: PG refs/pack-membership/operation/outbox transaction plus independently verified remote encrypted pack/index/envelope objects. Vault Transit protects keys; local plaintext work/cache is disposable.
entries.authority_target: BlobStore pack/idx receipt + PgRefStore CommitRefs token
entries.durable_ack: Remote encrypted objects must be uploaded/read-back verified and protected by the existing retention ledger before the PG publication transaction succeeds.
entries.notes: This path is not backed by OpenDAL Blob and does not provide a cross-service commit token.
gaps: Current remote protocol is handwritten S3-compatible, not OpenDAL; Vault remains required.
No stable caller operation receipt/cancel or new persistent-hold contract.

entries.authority_current: storage/remote_objects adapter selects Local when ROOTYARD_OBJECT_STORE_ENDPOINT is absent; S3 path requires bucket/region/keys and loopback or TLS
entries.authority_target: BlobStore with no fs/memory production fallback and explicit capability rejection
entries.durable_ack: put completion is provider-dependent; there is no unified receipt/capability contract
entries.notes: The explicit Local fallback is the baseline behavior that target configuration validation must reject.
gaps: no OpenDAL Operator
Local fallback
hand-written S3 request path
no capability/consistency/conditional-create contract
